description: A modern social discovery and companionship platform for adults to find people to attend social activities, events, and lifestyle experiences. The platform bridges digital trust with physical world connection.
vibe: Premium, trustworthy, modern, mobile-first, exclusive yet accessible (The Modern Social Club). Think Soho House aesthetics meets high-end lifestyle tech.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' approach adapted for lifestyle. We avoid generic corporate sans-serifs for headings. We need a typeface that speaks to culture, curation, and premium experiences.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3, and major callouts. Never use Inter for headings.

hierarchy_rules: H1 (Hero): text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]

colors.strategy: Archetype 5: Luxury (Light Mode). Bone-white backgrounds, Midnight Navy accents, and structural grays for high-contrast, sophisticated clarity.
rules: No pure #FFFFFF backgrounds for the main body; use #FAFAFA (Bone White) to reduce eye strain and feel more premium.
Primary actions and bold accents must use the Midnight Navy (#0F172A).
Avoid all generic 'tech blue' or 'dating app pink/red'. Maintain a neutral, sophisticated palette.

layouts.strategy: Generous spacing. The 'Bento' Grid Protocol for marketing sections and high-density, cardless/flat grids for dashboards.

patterns.homepage: Bento grids for 'Discover Events' and 'Featured Experiences'. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Asymmetric alignments to break the 'template' look.
patterns.dashboards: High-density Grid Mode. 1px solid strokes for borders (border-slate-200), max 12px border-radius (rounded-xl), minimal shadows.
patterns.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for marketing, rounded-xl for dashboards). Internal padding must be generous (p-6 or p-8).

layouts.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80). Minimalist layout. Mobile-first bottom navigation for the PWA dashboard experience.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid for data/dashboards (clean, clinical trust). Crystal Glassmorphism for floating navs and modal overlays.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke (border-slate-200) to separate containers from the background.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient, diffuse shadows only (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]). Never use harsh default drop shadows.

motion.strategy: Smooth, purposeful, premium. No excessive bouncing.
interactions: Lists: Staggered fade-up entrances using framer-motion.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or soft-rect (rounded-xl). Primary uses bg-[#0F172A] text-white. No default HTML buttons.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI forms, customized with rounded-xl, bg-white, border-slate-200, focus:ring-slate-900.
components.cards: Profile cards (Companions) must focus heavily on the image (aspect ratio 3:4 or 4:5), with text overlay as a gradient from black/60 to transparent at the bottom.
components.toasts: Use Sonner component (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx) for all notifications.

media.image_strategy: High-quality lifestyle imagery showcasing authentic connection. No corny stock photos. Focus on lighting, mood, and diversity.

hero_background.description: Stylish group dinner with drinks in a cozy setting. Represents premium social dining.

discover_nightlife.description: People dancing at a formal event. Represents premium nightlife and parties.

discover_cafe.description: Friends enjoying conversation over coffee. Represents casual daytime meetups.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent) to pass APCA/WCAG contrast minimums.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a high-contrast focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-slate-900).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based, e.g., data-testid='hero-join-cta').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building Buddilio.com - a premium social club PWA.
Install required icon library: yarn add lucide-react
Install animation library: yarn add framer-motion
Do NOT build generic center-aligned Vercel template designs. Apply the E1 persona - make it look like a high-end editorial lifestyle product.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page marketing sections to achieve bento grids and overlapping layouts. Use Shadcn for the Dashboard, Forms, and Modals.
Implement a mobile-first approach. Ensure touch targets are at least 48x48px on mobile.
Avoid using card components excessively. Go for cardless, rectangular, flat designs for dense dashboards.
For the companion profile cards, ensure they do not look like Tinder (dating). Focus on shared interests, professional background, and lifestyle vibes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-xl) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use clean Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, transitions, entrance animations).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Do not use placeholder text for images or logos. Use the provided high-quality image URLs.
All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit').
